RDG._who: John, November 24th 2026: platform 3 is round a small corner from 7, not across the platform from it; Reading's footbridge is "the bridge"

HER._who: John, November 27th 2026: between the platforms, down the steps and round by Molesey Road, under the railway bridge
HER.road: which means taking the steps down and going round by the road under the railway bridge

PAD._who: John, November 28th 2026: platforms next to each other are 2 and 3, 4 and 5, 6 and 7, 8 and 9, 10 and 11; any other two of 1 to 12, onto the concourse and round; 14 by the small footbridge (onto platform 8 for the concourse); the Elizabeth Line out through Eastbourne Terrace. pairs: [from, to, words], first match wins, both ways unless both are given. John, November 28th 2026 (later): the small footbridge meets the main footbridge by platform 8, so 1 to 7 and 14 go by the footbridges; 10 to 12 and 1 to 9: the concourse or the footbridges.
